newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Weakening gilts to head for 113-16.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Weakening gilts to head for 113-16.

text.p: September gilt futures on LIFFE were in line for a push down towards the 113-16 area on Tuesday after a poor close in the previous session, technical analysts said.

"We had a pretty soft session and close near the lows yesterday," said Gerry Celaya, senior technical analyst at American Express Bank in London. "We're looking for a move below 113-26 -- yesterday's low -- and we'll see if we can get into the mid-113-00 zone."
He said the first stop down would be the 113-16 area, support from the high on June 23.
"If we get down there then there's a good chance later on we'll try to get to 112-25 which is the low from June 24," Celaya said. That level forms the trough of June's trading zone on daily charts.
"But for today, 113-26 and 113-16 should be the levels to watch for gilts on the downside," he said.
To the upside, Celaya said the contract would look more perky if it started getting back above congestion at 114-00,02.
That might give the gilts a chance at Monday's high at 114-18, he said. The major upside target however remains just below 115-00 with the contract high coming in at 114-31 on May 9.
September gilts were quoted up 4/32 at 114-01 just after the opening at 0702 GMT.
Technical analysts at Chase in London said trendline support on intra-day charts around 113-26 on Monday stemmed the contract's fall.

"Provided that it holds this level some corrective upside activity is likely, but failure to break 114-07 will put it under renewed pressure," they said in a research note. "A break of 113-26 suggests an initial test of 113-13, represented by trendline support on daily charts."
December short sterling futures were up 0.01 at 92.73.
